rows.text:
If water is coming into your house right now, call 999 first and follow the instructions they give you. I cannot check conditions at your home.
1. Call 999 now and tell them where you are and that water is entering your home.
2. Move to a higher floor or higher part of the building. Do not go into the water.
3. Take medicines, identification, your phone and charger, and help anyone who needs assistance.
4. If you are told to leave, go to the evacuation centre the authorities direct you to.
5. When you are able, tell me your location or nearest landmark and I can look up the nearest evacuation centre and a route to it.
Worth knowing:
• Do not walk or drive through floodwater.
• Only turn off electricity at the main switch if you can reach it without standing in water.
• Follow official guidance from MBSA, JPS or NADMA.

• 这是模拟假设：只有现场检查通过，行程才会被确认；结果不是承诺。

• Segment facts are demo values, not yet surveyed.
